blocks.text: The Zscaler and Exaforce Deployment Guide provides instructions on using Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) features with the Exaforce platform.

This guide walks you through the onboarding process to establish a secure connection between your Zscaler environment and the Exaforce platform, enabling automated log collection and security monitoring.
The guide helps you with configuring API roles, registering API clients, connecting your Zscaler instance through the Exaforce Console, and setting up log source feeds.
